test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2021: Official Paper (Held On : 6 June 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
The following sentence has been split into four segments. Identify the segment that contains a grammatical error. 

Me and my friends / often go / to the cinema / together.
solution:
The correct answer is** "Me and my friends "** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** We will learn the correct sentence:

 
• ***My friends and I​***&am
